description: Updates a Salesforce task with status Completed, optional completion notes, and additional field values. Additional field values can override the status or description set by the action.

completion_notes.description: Optional notes to add about the task completion. Will be appended to existing description.
examples: Call completed successfully. Customer agreed to proceed.
completion_notes.human_parameter_description: Any short note you want to include when closing the task. This will be added to the task’s description for context and tracking.
completion_notes.title: Completion Notes

custom_fields.description: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names typically end with '__c' (e.g., 'Completion_Source__c').
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: Provide custom Salesforce fields to update alongside completion. Use the API field name (ending in '__c') as the key.
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

task_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the task to mark as completed.
task_id.human_parameter_description: The unique Salesforce ID of the task you want to mark as completed. You can copy it from the task’s URL or use an ID from a previous step.
task_id.title: Task Id

name: complete_task

CompleteTaskResponse.description:
Response for successful task completion.

HTTP 204 No Content - Salesforce returns empty body on successful update.
Error responses (4xx/5xx) are handled via raise_for_status().
CompleteTaskResponse.title: CompleteTaskResponse
